trap.label: say × tell
trap.wrong: I’m afraid I can’t say you the figures.
trap.right: I’m afraid I can’t tell you the figures.
trap.why: Em português “dizer” cobre say e tell. Em inglês, tell leva objeto pessoa (tell you); say não leva (say it to you).

fix.wrong: Please exercise discrete with this report.
fix.right: Please exercise discretion with this report.

fix.wrong: I said him it was confidential.
fix.right: I told him it was confidential.

fix.wrong: It would be better to not share it.
fix.right: It would be better not to share it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com tell: “I can’t say you the figures.” (corrija)
rewrite.answer: I can’t tell you the figures.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com need-to-know: “Only people who need it can see this.” (on a …)
rewrite.answer: This is on a need-to-know basis.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com It would be better not to: “Please do not share it.”
rewrite.answer: It would be better not to share it.
